author: QueenMaeveOfOrna
body:
Welcome back! As far as the current event goes, the best way to jump into it would be to run some boss dungeons for the JoCs and Ymir Vritra Charm. Last year the Yelbeghen tower was released, and it had a lot of top notch gear for almost all classes. The astraltree was also released last year, and can help speed your progression. I think if I was in your position, I would use some of the AP you gain from the current event on Constellationseeds and hope for a Yelmogus Thinblade or something of the sorts from the ornate nodes on the astraltree. If you have RS dorado unlocked, and you don't have an Argos from ornaversary, it would also be worth getting a fallen sky helmet for some extra VD if you don't have one. I main RS so feel free to ask me any questions you have, and you can add me in game.

IGN: Queen Maeve

author: carnifexor
body: People are very happy to answer questions on the discord as you relearn. There are also some "guides" for Real shifter that can be found there. There's an event right now that's pretty good for farming, so make the most of the next month if you can.
